footer.tagline: Turning waste into art, and art into impact.

home.heroSubtitle: RenewCanvas Africa connects recycled materials with talented artists to create unique, impact-verified artwork. Every piece tells a story of transformation.
home.aboutP1: RenewCanvas Africa is a technology-driven circular arts platform that transforms the waste crisis into creative opportunity. We collect specific recyclable materials, distribute them to curated artists, and connect their unique creations with buyers who value sustainability and impact.
home.aboutP2: Every artwork on our platform comes with a verified environmental impact story, so you will know exactly how much waste was diverted, which artist created it, and the journey from discarded material to treasured art piece.
home.aboutP3: We are not just a marketplace. We are a movement to prove that waste can be beautiful, that African artists deserve global recognition, and that conscious consumers can make a real difference.
home.howTitle: From Waste to Wonder in Four Steps
home.howSubtitle: Our platform creates a transparent, traceable journey from discarded materials to cherished artwork.
home.step1Desc: We source recyclable materials (plastics, fabrics, metals) from verified partners, clean and sort them for artistic use.
home.step2Desc: Our curated artists transform these materials into stunning paintings, sculptures, jewelry, and home décor.
home.step3Desc: Every artwork is logged with its environmental impact: kg of waste diverted, materials used, and artist earnings.
home.step4Desc: Purchase unique art, commission custom pieces, or sponsor donations to schools. Every action creates real impact.
home.impactSubtitle: Every purchase on RenewCanvas Africa contributes to measurable environmental and social impact.
home.statArtworksDesc: Unique pieces with verified impact stories
home.whyTitle: Art With Purpose, Impact With Proof
home.whySubtitle: RenewCanvas Africa is not just another art marketplace. We are building a transparent, traceable circular economy for creative expression.
home.why1Desc: Every artwork comes with documented environmental impact: kg of waste diverted and materials traced.
home.why2Desc: Our artists are vetted for skill and commitment. You are buying from talented, verified creators.
home.why3Desc: Celebrating African creativity and craftsmanship while solving a local environmental challenge.
home.why4Desc: Support school donations, artist training, and community clean-up initiatives through your purchase.
home.ctaSubtitle: Whether you want to buy unique art, join as an artist, or partner with us for corporate impact, there is a place for you in the RenewCanvas community.

howItWorks.heroSubtitle: Discover how we transform discarded materials into stunning artwork while empowering African artists and creating measurable environmental impact.
howItWorks.processSubtitle: A transparent, traceable journey from discarded materials to cherished artwork in your space.
howItWorks.step1Desc: We partner with waste pickers, recycling companies, schools, and businesses to collect specific recyclable materials. Each batch is documented with source information for full traceability.
howItWorks.step2Desc: All collected materials go through our rigorous cleaning and sorting process. We ensure only safe, sanitized materials reach our artists.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Our vetted artists receive cleaned materials and transform them into unique artwork. Each piece carries the story of its materials and creator.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Every artwork is logged with detailed impact metrics - kilograms of waste diverted, materials used, and artist earnings generated.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Approved artworks are listed on our marketplace with full impact stories, high-quality images, and transparent pricing.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Buyers discover and purchase unique, impact-verified artwork. Each sale supports artists directly and funds further waste collection.
howItWorks.bookCollectionPrompt: Have recyclable materials? Contribute to sustainability and earn discounts!

contact.faqSubheading: Quick answers to common questions about RenewCanvas Africa.
contact.faq1Question: How do I become an artist on RenewCanvas?
contact.faq1Answer: You can apply through our artist application form above. We review all applications and look for artists who are passionate about sustainable art and have a portfolio showcasing their work.
contact.faq2Question: What materials do you provide to artists?
contact.faq2Answer: We provide cleaned and sorted recyclable materials including plastic bottles, cardboard, fabric scraps, and more. All materials are sanitized and ready for creative use.
contact.faq3Question: How does the waste-to-discount program work?
contact.faq3Answer: Book a collection through our platform, and we will pick up your recyclable materials. You will receive discount codes based on the weight of materials contributed. The more you contribute, the bigger your discount on artwork purchases.
contact.faq4Answer: We are starting with local delivery in Rwanda and will expand to international shipping soon. Sign up to be notified when international shipping becomes available.
contact.faq5Answer: No. RenewCanvas admins handle order, delivery, return, and payment communication. Buyers pay RenewCanvas Africa directly, and artists receive payouts through their private payout details after the 48-hour return request window.

terms.section1Body1: Welcome to RenewCanvas Africa ("Platform", "we", "our", "us"). These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our platform and services. By accessing or using RenewCanvas Africa, you agree to be bound by these terms.
terms.section1Body2: RenewCanvas Africa is a circular economy marketplace connecting artists who create sustainable art from recycled materials with buyers who appreciate eco-conscious art.
terms.section2Def1: refers to registered users who create and sell artwork on the platform.
terms.section2Def2: refers to registered users who purchase artwork through the platform.
terms.section2Def3: refers to any art piece created from recycled or upcycled materials listed for sale on the platform.
terms.section2Def4: refers to all features and functionalities provided by RenewCanvas Africa.
terms.section3Body: To use our services, you must create an account. You agree to:
terms.section3Item1: Provide accurate and complete information during registration
terms.section3Item2: Maintain the security of your account credentials
terms.section3Item3: Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access
terms.section3Item4: Be at least 18 years old or have parental consent
terms.section3Item5: Accept responsibility for all activities under your account
terms.section4Body: As an artist on RenewCanvas Africa, you agree to:
terms.section4Item1: Create original artwork using recycled or upcycled materials
terms.section4Item2: Accurately describe your artwork, including materials used and dimensions
terms.section4Item3: Provide truthful information about the environmental impact of your materials
terms.section4Item4: Fulfill orders within the agreed timeframe
terms.section4Item6: Maintain the quality standards required by the platform
terms.section5Body: As a buyer on RenewCanvas Africa, you agree to:
terms.section5Item3: Inspect artwork upon delivery and report issues promptly
terms.section5Item4: Respect the intellectual property rights of artists
terms.section6Body: All prices are displayed in Rwandan Francs (RWF). We accept the following payment methods:
terms.section6Item1: MTN Mobile Money phone approval, with USSD fallback
terms.section6CommissionBody: RenewCanvas Africa retains 20% of each sale as a platform fee. Artists receive 80% of the sale price.
terms.section7Body: Artists retain full intellectual property rights to their artwork. By listing artwork on our platform, artists grant RenewCanvas Africa a non-exclusive license to display and promote their work.

privacy.section1Para1: RenewCanvas Africa ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform and services.
privacy.section1Para2: By using RenewCanvas Africa, you consent to the data practices described in this policy.
privacy.section2_1Intro: We collect information you provide directly, including:
privacy.section2_1Item1: Name and contact information (email, phone number, address)
privacy.section2_1Item3: Payment information (processed securely through payment providers)
privacy.section2_1Item4: Profile information (bio, profile photo, social media links)
privacy.section2_2Item2: Materials used and environmental impact data
privacy.section2_3Intro: We automatically collect certain information when you visit our platform:
privacy.section3Intro: We use the collected information for:
privacy.section3Item3: Verifying artist identities and artwork authenticity
privacy.section3Item4: Calculating and displaying environmental impact metrics
privacy.section3Item5: Communicating with you about orders, updates, and promotions
privacy.section3Item6: Improving our platform and user experience
privacy.section4Intro: We may share your information with:
privacy.section4Item1Text: Artists and buyers can see each other's relevant information to facilitate transactions
privacy.section4Item2Text: Third parties who help us operate our platform (payment processors, hosting services)
privacy.section4Item3Text: When required by law or to protect our rights
privacy.section4Item4Text: In case of merger, acquisition, or sale of assets
privacy.section4Outro: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.section5Intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your information, including:
privacy.section5Item1: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
privacy.section5Outro: However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.section6Intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
privacy.section6Item1: Remember your preferences and login status
privacy.section6Outro: You can control cookies through your browser settings, but some features may not function properly without them.
privacy.section7Item5: Data portability (receive your data in a usable format)
privacy.section7Outro: To exercise these rights, contact us at {{email}}.
privacy.section8Intro: We retain your information for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes described in this policy. After account deletion:
privacy.section8Item1: Personal data is deleted within 30 days
privacy.section8Item2: Transaction records may be retained for legal and accounting purposes (up to 7 years)
privacy.section8Item3: Anonymized data may be retained for analytics
privacy.section9Para1: Our platform is not intended for children under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected data from a minor, please contact us immediately.
privacy.section10Para1: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than Rwanda. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your data in accordance with applicable laws.
privacy.section11Para1: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any information.
privacy.section12Para1: Artists and users may submit content to the platform, including artwork images, profile details, descriptions, and messages ("User Content"). You are responsible for the content you submit and confirm you have the rights to share it. By submitting User Content you grant RenewCanvas Africa a non-exclusive licence to display, reproduce, and promote it for the operation and marketing of the marketplace.
privacy.section12Para2: We may review, moderate, or remove content that is unlawful, infringing, or violates our terms. To report content or request removal, contact us at {{email}}.
privacy.section13Para1: If you are a California resident, you have the right to know what personal information we collect and how we use it, to request access to or deletion of your personal information, to correct inaccurate information, and to not be discriminated against for exercising these rights.
privacy.section13Para2: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not "share" it for cross-context behavioural advertising as those terms are defined under the CPRA. To exercise your California rights, email {{email}} with the subject "California Privacy Request". We will verify your request before acting on it.
privacy.section14Para1: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes via email or platform notification. Your continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.section15Intro: For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact:

refundPolicy.title: Return & Refund Policy
refundPolicy.summaryWindowText: From delivery time for eligible return requests
refundPolicy.summaryCaseByCaseText: Change of mind returns reviewed individually
refundPolicy.overviewText: At RenewCanvas Africa, we want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines the conditions under which returns and refunds are processed. RenewCanvas Africa manages payment, delivery communication, return review, and artist payout release as the marketplace middleman.
refundPolicy.eligibleDamagedText: Artwork arrives damaged due to shipping issues (photos required within 48 hours of delivery)
refundPolicy.eligibleDifferentText: The artwork materially differs from the listing (size, materials, color discrepancies beyond normal variation)
refundPolicy.eligibleWrongItemText: You received an artwork different from what was ordered
refundPolicy.eligibleNotRepresentedText: Artwork was misrepresented in terms of recycled materials used
refundPolicy.caseChangeOfMindText: You no longer want the artwork (subject to RenewCanvas admin approval, restocking fee may apply)
refundPolicy.caseMinorVariationsText: Small differences inherent to handcrafted items
refundPolicy.notEligibleBuyerHandling: Artwork damaged after delivery due to buyer handling
refundPolicy.notEligibleLateRequest: Return requests opened after 48 hours without prior authorization
refundPolicy.notEligibleAlteredTags: Items with altered or removed artist tags/signatures
refundPolicy.step1Text: Email hello.renewcanvas@gmail.com within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and reason for return
refundPolicy.step2Text: Include photos of the artwork and packaging, especially for damage claims
refundPolicy.step3Text: We will review your request and respond within 2 business days with a Return Authorization (RA) number
refundPolicy.step4Text: Return the artwork in its original packaging with the RA number clearly marked
refundPolicy.step5Text: Once received and inspected, refund will be processed within 5-10 business days
refundPolicy.refundMethodsIntro: Refunds will be issued to the original payment method:
refundPolicy.refundCardText: Refund processed within 5-10 business days (may take longer depending on your bank)
refundPolicy.payoutHoldText: Buyer payments are made to RenewCanvas Africa, not directly to the artist. RenewCanvas holds the artist payout until 48 hours after delivery. If no eligible return request is opened during that window, the artist payout is released according to the platform payout schedule.
refundPolicy.shippingDamagedText: RenewCanvas Africa covers return shipping costs
refundPolicy.shippingChangeOfMindText: Buyer is responsible for return shipping costs
refundPolicy.shippingOriginalPackaging: Artwork must be returned in original packaging to prevent damage
refundPolicy.shippingTracked: We recommend using tracked shipping for returns
refundPolicy.restockingFeeIntro: A restocking fee of up to 15% may apply for:
refundPolicy.restockingChangeOfMind: Change of mind returns (if approved by RenewCanvas admin)
refundPolicy.restockingMinorDamage: Items with minor damage upon return
refundPolicy.cancelBeforePaymentText: Orders can be cancelled freely before payment is confirmed. No fees apply.
refundPolicy.cancelAfterPaymentText: Contact us immediately to request cancellation. Full refund will be processed if RenewCanvas has not yet released the order for shipment.
refundPolicy.cancelAfterShippingText: Cancellation is not possible once shipped. You may request a return upon delivery following the return process above.
refundPolicy.disputesIntro: If you are unsatisfied with our decision regarding your return or refund request:
refundPolicy.disputesEscalate: Contact our customer support team to escalate the issue
refundPolicy.disputesDocumentation: Provide any additional documentation or information
refundPolicy.disputesReview: A senior team member will review your case within 5 business days
refundPolicy.exchangesIntro: Direct exchanges are not available. To obtain a different artwork:
refundPolicy.exchangesStep1: Follow the return process for the original item
refundPolicy.exchangesStep2: Place a new order for the desired artwork
